environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2023 with Python 3.11, gunicorn 21.2.0. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering layer. The application is exposed directly to the internet with TLS termination at the NLB.
